title: CloudPricingOps Optimization Response
description: Defines the optimization recommendations returned by the Decision-Making and Optimization Engine to the Visualization Interface. Scores and costs are produced by the engine, not calculated by the interface.

recommendations.title: Optimization recommendations
recommendations.description: List of recommended cloud SKUs satisfying the submitted workload requirements.

sku_id.title: SKU identifier
sku_id.description: Identifier of the recommended SKU. Corresponds to SkuId in the canonical pricing catalog. Must be interpreted together with provider.

provider.title: Cloud provider
provider.description: Provider of the recommended SKU. Corresponds to ServiceProviderName in the canonical pricing catalog.

monthly_cost.title: Estimated monthly cost (USD)
monthly_cost.description: Estimated total monthly cost in USD for the requested workload configuration, as calculated by the Optimization Engine.

score.title: Optimization score
score.description: Normalized optimization score between 0 and 1. Higher scores indicate better recommendations. This interpretation is provisional and must be agreed with the Optimization Engine.

rationale.title: Recommendation rationale
rationale.description: Human-readable explanation of why the Optimization Engine recommended this SKU.
